source_name: Mastercard Newsroom - Europe press releases
why_relevant: Scheme-level announcements affecting SK acceptance (e.g. Click to Pay rollout to Slovakia) are issued from the Europe newsroom rather than a dedicated SK newsroom. Primary channel for scheme product/market-entry news.

source_name: Mastercard Incorporated - investor relations / SEC filings
why_relevant: Scheme-level volume, interchange and Europe-region commentary; regulatory/interchange developments affecting SK acceptance economics. No SK line item, but the authoritative baseline for scheme-side numbers.

source_name: Visa Inc. - investor relations / annual report
why_relevant: Same role as Mastercard IR on the Visa side: CEMEA/Europe payments volume, cross-border and pricing commentary that frames SK acceptance economics.

source_name: Slovensko plati kartou - Visa/Mastercard joint SK acceptance initiative
why_relevant: Joint scheme + partner-bank + PSP initiative promoting card acceptance among SK SMEs. Rare SK-specific artefact naming the acceptance-side coalition (which acquirers/PSPs participate) and publishing campaign-level acceptance data.

source_name: SBA - Slovenska bankova asociacia: Statistika vydavania a prijimania platobnych kariet
why_relevant: Monthly SK series explicitly covering card ACCEPTANCE ('prijimanie') as well as issuing: card counts, transaction counts/volumes, ATM and POS terminal transactions, mobile payments since 2019. The only recurring public SK acceptance-side quantitative series.

source_name: NBS - Platobne nastroje / platobne karty statistics
why_relevant: Central-bank statistics on SK payment instruments and cards; the regulatory baseline against which acquirer/processor claims about SK volumes can be checked. Also SIPS interbank system statistics for infrastructure context.

source_name: Register uctovnych zavierok (registeruz.sk) - statutory financial statements
why_relevant: Mandatory filing of full financial statements for SK legal entities. This is where SK-level revenue/profit of Nexi Central Europe a.s. (ICO 31372074), Global Payments s.r.o. organizacna zlozka (ICO 50010301) and Pay Solutions a.s. actually become visible - the group decks never break out Slovakia.

source_name: FinStat.sk - company financials & corporate-event profiles for SK payment entities
why_relevant: Aggregator that normalises registeruz + obchodny register data into revenue/profit time series and an event timeline, and preserves historical names (Nexi Central Europe a.s. <- SIA Central Europe a.s.; Global Payments Europe Slovakia s.r.o. v likvidacii). Fastest route to entity lineage across the First Data -> SIA -> Nexi chain.

source_name: FinReport.sk - keyword feed 'Platobne terminaly'
why_relevant: SK financial trade outlet with a dedicated terminal/acceptance tag. Reliably picks up acquirer and scheme announcements that never reach an English newsroom (SoftPOS launches, QR payment scheme, terminal fee changes).

source_name: SITA.sk - company tag page for Global Payments
why_relevant: Slovak news agency maintains per-company tag pages; SK corporate press releases are frequently distributed through SITA/webnoviny. An agency tag page is an efficient dated index of a given actor's SK announcements.

source_name: oPeniazoch.sk (openiazoch.zoznam.sk) - SK financial news archive
why_relevant: Long-running SK financial news archive; carries historical acquiring/outsourcing coverage (e.g. the Slovenska sporitelna payment-services outsourcing to Global Payments) useful for reconstructing the timeline of SK acceptance-market restructuring.

source_name: Pay Solutions, a.s. / Besteron - SK-licensed payment institution and gateway
why_relevant: SK-domiciled, NBS-regulated payment institution offering online card acceptance and POS terminals; acquired by the Solitea/IT holding group. A domestic acceptance-side actor that files SK statutory accounts, unlike the multinational acquirers.

source_name: TrustPay, a.s. - SK-headquartered payment institution / card acquiring
why_relevant: Bratislava-headquartered licensed payment institution (founded 2009) providing instant bank transfers and TrustCard card acceptance across SK banks. A domestic acceptance-side player whose SK statutory accounts and NBS licence entries are both retrievable.

source_name: Podnikajte.sk - comparative reviews of SK payment gateways and acceptance pricing
why_relevant: Periodically refreshed SK-market comparison of payment gateways/acceptance providers with fee structures. Reveals-indirectly: gives an observable proxy for SK acceptance pricing and which acquirers back which gateway.

source_name: NBS – SIPS payment system (system pages, rules, participants)
source_subtype: central bank / payment system operator portal
why_relevant: NBS is the operator of SIPS, the only domestic retail clearing system; its section publishes system rules, participation conditions and the operational framework that governs all SK interbank retail payments.

source_name: NBS – SIPS statistics (volume and value of processed transactions)
why_relevant: Time series of SIPS-processed SEPA credit transfers and direct debits since 2003 (monthly/daily, domestic vs cross-border) — the closest thing to a national payment-volume disclosure and a baseline for market sizing.

source_name: NBS – TARGET Services / TARGET-SK statistics
why_relevant: TARGET-SK is the only RTGS in Slovakia and the settlement layer for SIPS; its traffic statistics disclose large-value settlement activity of SK participants.

source_name: NBS – Access to NBS payment systems (participation conditions document, July 2025)
why_relevant: Sets out how non-bank PSPs (payment institutions, EMIs) may join SIPS/TARGET-SK from 6 Oct 2025 — a structural change in who can access national clearing, directly relevant to competitive landscape.

source_name: NBS – Oversight of payment systems (systems under oversight, oversight policy)
why_relevant: Enumerates which payment systems and schemes operating in SK are under NBS oversight — an authoritative actor map of national infrastructure operators and schemes.

source_name: NBS – Instant payments and Verification of Payee (okamžité platby)
why_relevant: Central authority page on SK instant-payment scheme adoption and the IPR/VoP obligations — the reference point for instant-payment rollout milestones by SK PSPs.

source_name: NBS Annual Report (Výročná správa NBS) – payment systems chapter
why_relevant: The NBS annual report contains a dedicated payment-systems chapter with SIPS/TARGET operating figures, incidents and infrastructure projects — a recurring, comparable disclosure series.

source_name: Slovenská pošta, a.s. – annual reports (výročné správy)
why_relevant: The national postal operator's annual report breaks out revenues from financial services alongside universal service — the only recurring public disclosure of the postal-financial channel that competes with and distributes for banks.

source_name: Slovenská pošta – financial services product pages and tariffs (SIPO, poštový poukaz, výber a prijatie peňazí)
why_relevant: Documents the actual postal payment instruments (SIPO collection, poštový poukaz na účet/na výplatu, cash in/out) with prices — the pricing benchmark for cash-based retail payments in SK and a change-detection surface for product shifts.

source_name: Slovenská pošta – news/press releases (články)
why_relevant: Announcements of changes to postal financial products, branch network and bank partnerships appear here first (e.g. SIPO document redesign effective Feb 2026).

source_name: Slovenská pošta – Poštové, obchodné a finančné podmienky (general terms)
why_relevant: Binding conditions for postal payment transactions; changes signal product/compliance shifts (e.g. AML limits, IBAN handling) ahead of any statistical disclosure.

source_name: Úrad pre reguláciu elektronických komunikácií a poštových služieb (RÚ) – report on universal service and postal payment transactions
why_relevant: The postal regulator's annual 'Správa o stave poskytovania univerzálnej služby a poštového platobného styku' is the only official series covering postal payment-transaction provision quality/volumes — a regulator-audited counterpart to Slovenská pošta's own report.

source_name: 365.bank / Poštová banka – annual reports and IR pages
why_relevant: The bank contractually distributing through ~all post offices; its consolidated annual report discloses the economics and duration of the Slovenská pošta partnership — the bridge between postal infrastructure and banking.

source_name: FinStat – Slovenská pošta, a.s. financial profile and filings
why_relevant: Aggregator of Slovak commercial-register and financial-statement data; gives machine-friendly revenue/profit series and corporate-register events for the postal operator and RÚ without waiting for the PDF annual report.
